name: Infoblox — DNS Resolution of Unsanctioned Cloud Storage
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Query"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "mega.nz" or xdm.event.description contains "anonfiles" or xdm.event.description contains "pcloud" or xdm.event.description contains "tresorit" or xdm.event.description contains "wetransfer" or xdm.event.description contains "filebin" or xdm.event.description contains "transfer.sh" or xdm.event.description contains "send.now" or xdm.event.description contains "dropbox" or xdm.event.description contains "drive.google" or xdm.event.description contains "box.com" or xdm.event.description contains "pastebin" or xdm.event.description contains "fileshare.io"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count_distinct(domain) as lookups,
       values(domain) as bad_domains,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, events_seen, bad_domains
description: Infoblox DNS query for mega.nz, anonfiles, pcloud, tresorit, wetransfer, filebin, transfer.sh, send.now, dropbox, drive.google, box.com, or pastebin — potential cloud-storage exfiltration target.
alert_name: Infoblox — DNS Resolution of Unsanctioned Cloud Storage
alert_description:
What fired: Infoblox DNS query for mega.nz, anonfiles, pcloud, tresorit, wetransfer, filebin, transfer.sh, send.now, dropbox, drive.google, box.com, or pastebin — potential cloud-storage exfiltration target.

Why it matters: data may be leaving the environment through this channel. Assessed severity: Medium.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1567.002 - Exfiltration Over Web Service: Cloud Storage (TA0010 - Exfiltration).

Investigate:
  - Quantify the volume and destination, and identify the user/host/principal moving the data.
  - Correlate with prior collection/staging and any defense-evasion steps; confirm the destination is not an approved service.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.

TA0010 - Exfiltration: T1567.002 - Exfiltration Over Web Service: Cloud Storage
